title: Warranty and return policy comparison before buying
description: Pull out the return and warranty terms that actually matter across retailers and score the risk before buying.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: warranty-return-policy-check
  title: Warranty and return policy comparison before buying
  description: Pull out the return and warranty terms that actually matter across retailers and score the risk before buying.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Make sure a shopper understands the real return window, fees, and warranty coverage before committing to a purchase.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: stop
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Retailer policy pages
      summary: The product plus the retailer policy pages, terms, or receipts to review.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The product being bought, plus the retailer return policy, warranty terms, or receipt text for each retailer under consideration. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: extract-retailer-a
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Policy extractor, first retailer
      summary: Pulls the return and warranty terms out of the first retailer's policy text.
      role: Careful reader who turns dense policy language into plain terms.
      prompt: Read the first retailer's return policy and warranty text and extract the actual terms in plain language, such as the return window, restocking fee, warranty length, and who pays return shipping. Quote or closely paraphrase the source rather than assuming a standard industry term applies. Note explicitly any term that is not stated or is ambiguous in the source text.
      capabilities: { skills: [compliance-review], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: extract-retailer-b
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Policy extractor, second retailer
      summary: Pulls the return and warranty terms out of the second retailer's policy text and combines them with the first.
      role: Careful reader who turns dense policy language into plain terms.
      prompt: Read the second retailer's return policy and warranty text and extract the actual terms in plain language, such as the return window, restocking fee, warranty length, and who pays return shipping. Combine this with the first retailer's extracted terms into one side-by-side set, without changing or assuming anything about the first retailer's terms. Note explicitly any term that is not stated or is ambiguous in the source text.
      capabilities: { skills: [compliance-review], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: select-key-terms
      kind: transform
      name: Select the terms that matter
      summary: Narrow the extracted policies down to the fields that actually drive risk.
      config: { operation: select, expression: "keep only return window, restocking fee, warranty length, and who pays return shipping for each retailer" }
    - id: risk-evaluate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Purchase risk score
      summary: Score how risky each retailer's terms are for this purchase.
      role: Neutral evaluator scoring buyer risk from stated policy terms alone.
      prompt: Using the selected terms, score how much buyer risk each retailer's return and warranty terms create, such as a short return window, a high restocking fee, a short warranty, or shipping costs the buyer must cover. Base the score only on the terms actually extracted, and treat any missing or ambiguous term as added risk rather than assuming a favorable default. Explain the specific terms driving the score for each retailer.
      capabilities: { skills: [risk-analysis], tools: [read, calculate], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Policy risk comparison
      summary: The side-by-side terms and risk score for each retailer.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: extract-retailer-a, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: extract-retailer-a, to: extract-retailer-b, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: extract-retailer-b, to: select-key-terms, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: select-key-terms, to: risk-evaluate, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: risk-evaluate, to: result, kind: data }
